caption: The image shows a round ceramic plate with intricate decorations. The central part of the plate depicts a scenic landscape with trees, a small human figure—possibly riding a horse—in the foreground, and a town or village with buildings and hills in the distance beneath a cloudy sky. Surrounding the central scene, the wide rim of the plate is adorned with large, detailed floral patterns, including blossoms and leaves, which repeat around the edge. The plate is rendered in monochrome, with shades of gray varying from light to dark, indicating that the image is in black and white. The plate is positioned upright against a plain light background, casting a shadow to the left.
title: Plate - "View of Washington"
